claim.value: A cleaning entry together with an independent readiness check could support a finding that cleaning was still incomplete at the next scheduled start.
claim.scope: An illustrative possibility, not an observed finding; the temporal reference is the next scheduled start introduced within the same span.

provenance.rationale: The span supplies the evidence combination, possible cleaning-status finding and temporal reference.

signal_basis.value: A cleaning record and an independently grounded readiness check converge on cleaning remaining incomplete at the relevant scheduled start, with source access and dependence assessed.
signal_basis.scope: Agreement concerns the same equipment, booking, handoff and time. It supports the specific cleaning-status feature, subject to credible access and independence; it does not establish the cause of lateness.

provenance.rationale: The cited bundle supplies the specific corroboration example, identity matching, source assessment and limits on status and causal inference.
No additional unresolved empirical relation is required for this bounded possibility claim.

rationale: Credible independent agreement about cleaning status at the scheduled start licenses increased support for that status finding. The claim asserts only possible evidential support, without claiming certainty or that incomplete cleaning caused the late start.
uncertainty: The packet does not report that this illustrative convergence actually occurred; the judgment assumes the described signal as instructed.
